Our mark

Every line on this site is a level set of one function, z(x,y)z(x,y)z(x,y): the points where zzz takes a given value. Economists draw the same object as indifference curves, along which utility is constant, and isoquants, along which output is constant. The cover, the page banners and the map are windows on this one surface.

The sliders set the four amplitudes: a1a_1a1​ for the ridge just below the bottom edge, a2a_2a2​ for the hollow at the lower right, a3a_3a3​ for the hill above the top edge and a4a_4a4​ for the hollow on the left edge. @dataclass(frozen=True)
class Bump:
    """One anisotropic Gaussian: amplitude, centre, axis lengths, rotation (radians)."""

    amp: float
    cx: float
    cy: float
    sx: float
    sy: float
    theta: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Field:
    bumps: tuple[Bump, ...]
    tilt: tuple[float, float]

    def __call__(self, x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        z = self.tilt[0] * x + self.tilt[1] * y
        for b in self.bumps:
            c, s = np.cos(b.theta), np.sin(b.theta)
            u = c * (x - b.cx) + s * (y - b.cy)
            v = -s * (x - b.cx) + c * (y - b.cy)
            z = z + b.amp * np.exp(-0.5 * ((u / b.sx) ** 2 + (v / b.sy) ** 2))
        return z
